posts.author: Ebon_Maker5
posts.body:
So I'm making a game that uses enemies that are already preset on the map and will chase you if you're close enough- does anyone know how to make it so the enemy makes an "alert noise" or even a exclamation mark popup above its head? (The game is HEAVILY based off fear and hunger) however I can't use the plugins the dev used because I was use MZ not MV
Furthermore- what would be the best way to make an enemy follow you and eventually loose interest? I have an idea how to do it myself but it's sloppy and very basic lol

posts.author: fizzly
posts.body:
Try to study free game/sample called
Wolf's Gang
(can be opened in RPG Maker as a project) made officialy for RMMZ premiere. There's simple "enemy hasing" mechanic and works quite well
The other option is plugin: MOG_Event_Sensor, can be found
here
